QF.id: Cat III AIF Overview and Growth_14

question.text: Compared to Cat I and Cat II AIFs, Cat III AIFs:

answer.text: Can be either open-ended or close-ended

explanation.text: **The Logic:** Cat III AIFs are unique in being structured as either open-ended or close-ended (Cat I/II are mandatorily close-ended). **The Trap:** Other differences don't apply. **Cross-Exam Context:** Key structural differentiator. **Distributor's Pro-Tip:** Match structure (open vs close-ended) to client's liquidity needs.
